title: Orzo with Feta, Cucumber and Tomato
description: This recipe features tender orzo pasta combined with cucumbers, feta cheese, tomatoes, and Greek olives to make a great light lunch for summer days.
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeded and chopped - divided
1 red onion, very thinly sliced and cut into 1-inch pieces
1 cup pitted Kalamata olives, coarsely chopped
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring orzo, chicken broth, water, and 1/2 bell pepper to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to low; simmer until orzo tender and liquid has been absorbed, about 10 minutes. Drain and rinse; cool.

Transfer orzo mixture to a large bowl. Add remaining 1/2 bell pepper and 2 tablespoons olive oil; toss to coat. Stir in cucumbers, feta cheese, Roma tomatoes, red onion, Kalamata olives, lemon juice, white wine vinegar, and cumin; toss well. Drizzle remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil over top.
Refrigerate salad for 1 hour. Toss before serving once or twice; season to with salt and black pepper.
